summary: Builds a display string for a menu entry from an action index: retrieves the module pointer from the ppvOut array and the action name from the dword_7D1B08 table (stride 7), copies the module name into the shared display buffer byte_5EC4CC when present in the string table, concatenates the module and action path into the caller's output buffer, and optionally creates a UI menu item when the a3 flag is set.

operations.description: Retrieve the module pointer for index a1 from the ppvOut array via ArrayIndexedAccessor.
Retrieve the action name string from the dword_7D1B08 table entry at index 7 * a1 via sub_455260.
Guard that both the module pointer and the caller's output buffer a2 are non-null; if either is null the build path is skipped and only the flag is returned.
When the module name is found in the string table by BinarySearchInStringTable, copy it into the shared display buffer byte_5EC4CC.
Copy byte_5EC4CC into the output buffer a2 and normalise it with StrlenOverwrite.
When an action name exists, look it up in the string table via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy it into byte_5EC4CC; otherwise fall back to the default path byte_5EA438.
Append the action path to the output buffer with strcat and prepare the return value as the a3 flag.
When the a3 flag is set, create the UI menu item from the built string via UIMenuItemCreator.
Return the a3 flag (as a char) indicating whether a UI menu item was created.
Called by SessionEntryListCleanup (0x0046AE60) to build menu item display strings for session entries.
